fields.statement: At 0d719dfe4 I ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestDaemonModelPR: PASS for Green (a fake gh's pr merge squash-merges into origin/main; branches deleted, HEAD == origin/main, no untracked .rhiza/log left, entries present, no inbox item), red and conflict (nothing merged, branches kept, an inbox model-pr item names the change set), and GhFailureNeverFails. go test ./internal/daemon -run TestSelfUpdate: all 7 PASS, including TestSelfUpdateDropsIncomingLogCopies (an untracked copy byte-identical to what origin/main adds is dropped, the fast-forward succeeds and the file becomes tracked, and a differing untracked file is kept). go vet and gofmt are clean, and TestScripts/describe-golden passes. In the diff, daemonMergeModelPRs is called from the daemon poll after daemonCommitUntracked; it runs gh pr merge --squash --match-head-commit, then git push --delete, then pullMainAfterModelMerge (dropIncomingLogCopies, then pull --ff-only, and main-stale if blocked); SelfUpdate.Dir is set in both the root and the project paths.
